Team,

Quick context: Greenhouse renewal comes up end of Q3. We ran a short internal audit and there are three parallel asks: (1) confirm whether we can consolidate downstream workflows into a single talent platform, (2) validate SSO / SCIM gaps before cutting any migrations, and (3) capture any opportunity to renegotiate list pricing before the renewal.

Attached: Greenhouse_Q3-2027-Quote.pdf and LMS_TCO_snapshot.xlsx. The vendor account rep said they can provide an updated quote if we send a consolidated seat list and desired features.

Asks for this thread:
- Laura: can you confirm headcount allocation vs hiring plan so we can finalize seats?
- Monica (People Ops): can you list integrations we rely on today (background checks, LMS, payroll)?
- Steph (Security): flag any SSO/SCIM or data-retention blockers you see.

I'll reach out to Greenhouse + our LMS vendor for an updated consolidated proposal. If we can demonstrate migration path + single sign-on parity, we should aim to lock a 12-month term with early renewal pricing.

Propose we sync Fri 07/02 for 30 mins after Monica circles back.

Thanks,
Marcus

Hi Emma / WorkLMS / Checkr team —

We are evaluating a consolidation of our talent stack ahead of Greenhouse's Q3 renewal. I’ve attached platform_requirements_v2.docx and a seat map (see Drive link in the thread metadata). Can you confirm the following in a consolidated response: 

1) Pricing: a line-item breakdown for current seat count (see attached) plus delta for FY28 hires; any available renewal discounts for multi-product commitments.
2) SSO / SCIM: support for SP-initiated SSO with our IdP (Okta), SCIM provisioning and deprovisioning SLA, and whether admin-level JIT provisioning is supported.
3) Data retention & export: how customer data (candidate history, assessment results) can be exported to our LMS for training metadata and to our archival store (format, APIs).
4) Timeline & migration assistance: what professional services or partner resources are available and typical timeline for migrating candidate training artifacts and transcripts into an LMS (WorkLMS or otherwise).

We’re aiming to have a consolidated, comparable 12-month quote and an optional 24-month pricing scenario by EOD Fri 7/2. Please include any contract redline templates or standard addenda (DPA, security appendix).

Thanks — Marcus

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Thanks for the clear ask and attachments. Quick answers below and I've attached an updated quote.

Pricing: We can extend our FY27 renewal promotional pricing if you commit to a 12-month term by 7/15. Attached Greenhouse_Updated_Quote_v2.pdf includes seat tiers and a blended discount for multi-product purchases.

SSO/SCIM: Greenhouse supports SP-initiated SSO with Okta and full SCIM provisioning. Deprovisioning can be configured with a 24-hour SLA for automated removals; JIT provisioning is supported for invite flows. We will share a technical spec for Okta mapping.

Data export: Candidate objects, scorecards, and offer history can be exported via API in JSON/CSV. For LMS transfer we typically deliver a CSV + SCORM metadata bundle; professional services can help map fields.

Migration assistance: We have a partners program; estimated timeline for candidate artifact export and LMS ingestion is 4-6 weeks with a small professional services engagement.

DocuSign: I can generate a DocuSign envelope with the updated quote and our standard DPA.

Emma Singh
Strategic Accounts
Greenhouse
